svg.title: Between modules: public query and event dependencies
svg.desc: Nine cross-context query dependencies and sixteen event-contract dependencies at baseline 0d5e64b. Arrows point from importer to contract owner. Tagging registry, Audit composition and native facade imports are explained separately.
svg.text: EXPLICIT MODULES / DEPENDENCY FIELD GUIDE / 03
Between modules
Public contracts expose the coupling. Each context retains its own write implementation.
A → B means A imports B. Every arrow is a source dependency.
01 SUPPORTED READS
A package in the source context imports
the target context’s public queries package.
9 edges · non-surface production packages
Models may also cross these public seams.
02 EVENT CONTRACTS
A receiving handler imports the event type
from the context that owns the fact.
16 edges · arrow points toward the event owner
Runtime delivery runs the other way.
OTHER DEPENDENCIES HAVE DISTINCT JOBS

a.text: Target registration; domain edits publish TagsReplaced to Tagging’s leaf handlers.
app.New injects the audit writer and dispatcher into the pipeline.
Public facade imports compose screens; peer surfaces and private writes stay inaccessible.

svg.text: RECIPROCAL BUSINESS RELATIONSHIPS CAN STILL FORM AN ACYCLIC PACKAGE GRAPH.
Orders reads inventory/queries; Inventory reacts through inventory/handlers → orders/events.
The generated dispatcher imports event types and receivers. Commands publish their own events.
These views omit standard library, third-party and other shared-package imports.
Ryan Harris / thefellow.github.io / source baseline 0d5e64b
Open the SVG to follow package links.
